name: playgama-plugins
description: Playgama's plugin for AI coding agents: publish web games on Playgama.

plugins.name: playgama-developer-cabinet
plugins.description: Publish and manage HTML5 games on Playgama from an agent: create games, upload builds and covers, edit in-app products and leaderboards, get QA links, publish a playable sandbox and bring its first players. Its skills check and pack a build, integrate the Bridge SDK and make a trailer of the game.
